_doc: The screens as console lines, hand-written. A line is `style:text`, or `text` alone in the style text; \t separates its parts. Lines {INFO:...} are required information (wording free; scenarios match content). Exact lines are compared character for character. `titles` names each screen in the title bar; `status` gives the status bar's two words, each as `color:word` (amber, dim or unlit); `running` is the running slot's index, null when it is not established.

start._doc: S-15.163: a failed plain start. `start` is struct s15_start (why and check by their enum names, cmd and at as S-09 numbers them); `slave` is Device Info's DSP2 state at held mode's start (enum s15_slave), `lost` also says the slave has stopped answering since. `main` is the notice's second line on the main screen, under error:The OS could not be started.; `info` is Device Info's OS start value (at most 42 characters) and `dsp2` its DSP2 value. The first case is the one main_start_lost and info_start_lost show.
